name: Cuivre Island-Mississippi River
about: Cuivre Island-Mississippi River drains about 28 square miles, 56% of it in St. Charles County. The land ranges from about 660 feet above sea level at its highest point to about 420 feet at its lowest. Its main streams are Belleau Creek and Cuivre Slough. Downstream, its water passes through the Bolter Island-Mississippi River, Marais Temps Clair-Mississippi River and City of Alton-Mississippi River watersheds on its way down the Mississippi River.
